parsed.name: Yoctopuce 接近传感器
parsed.description: 用于检测物体接近与离开状态的接近传感器，可读取接近信号值、存在状态和脉冲计数，并可配置检测阈值、迟滞以及存在/移除最小时间，适合实验装置中的到位检测、非接触触发和状态监测。
parsed.description_en: A proximity sensor for detecting object approach and removal. It can read the proximity signal value, presence state, and pulse count, and supports configuration of detection threshold, hysteresis, and minimum presence/removal times. It is suitable for in-lab position detection, non-contact triggering, and status monitoring.

actions.description: 设置存在事件的最小检测时间。
actions.description_en: Set the minimum detection time for a presence event.

actions.description: 设置移除事件的最小检测时间。
actions.description_en: Set the minimum detection time for a removal event.

actions.description: 重置脉冲计数器及其计时器。
actions.description_en: Reset the pulse counter and its timer.

actions.description: 枚举下一个可访问的接近传感器。
actions.description_en: Enumerate the next accessible proximity sensor.
